postings.help: Tooltip beside the title of the Postings page: what the page is for.
postings.col.place: Column header of the postings table: where the job is (and, under it, the term).
postings.filter.more: Button that opens the less used filters of the postings list; also the name of the filter row.

postings.dueTip: Tooltip on a posting's deadline in the table. {when} is a date and time.
postings.noDeadline: Tooltip on the dash shown for a posting without a deadline.
postings.sourceSaysJd: Shown under the job description field of the edit form when the source's text differs from the applicant's correction; followed by the link 'Use the source's value'.
runs.stopsAfter: Activity, plan: what 'Finishing' means. {n}: tasks still running. Plural.
runs.days: Scheduled tasks: an interval in whole days, beside the minutes field. Plural.

runs.waitsFor: Activity, plan: second line of a task that waits for the applicant. {what}: what it waits for.

runs.col.status: Activity, history: column header of a task's outcome state; also the name of the all / incomplete switch.

runs.col.when: Activity, history: column header of when the task ended (or started).

runs.details: Activity, history: name of the button that opens a row.
runs.noDetails: Activity, history: shown in an opened row that has no summary and no technical details.
profile.referenceN: Profile, salary and references: heading of a reference that has no name yet. {n}: its number.

profile.revokeAsk: Profile: question before revoking a line the app noted.
profile.fileKind: Profile, 'Generate from résumé': accessible name of the select beside 'Choose file'.
profile.sizeOf: Profile, version history: size of a version. Plural.
profile.col.change: Profile, version history: column header of what a version changed.
profile.col.by: Profile, version history: column header of who made the version (you, the app, generated).
profile.col.saved: Profile, version history: column header of when the version was saved.
files.page.folders: Files: accessible name of the folder list.
files.filter.label: Files: button that opens the list's filters.
files.writtenFor: Files, preview: label before the posting a file was written for.
todos.dismiss: Action required: menu item that closes a card without doing it (the app may bring it back when work waits for it).
todos.lastTryDidNotWork: Action required: on a sign-in card after a failed attempt; the raw reason is under 'Technical details'.
todos.what.mail: Action required: explanation of an 'email not matched' card. {subject}: the email's subject; {body}: its summary.
todos.what.mailOnly: Action required: explanation of an 'email not matched' card without a summary. {subject}: the email's subject.
mail.toFill: Outgoing mail: warning that blocks sending. {n}: places left to fill in. Plural.
mail.removeFile: Outgoing mail: name of the button that removes an attachment. {name}: the file's name.
remote.titleOf: Remote window: page title. {what}: what the window is for (Sign in, Application form); {title}: the site or page.
remote.typedStays: Remote window: privacy statement under the picture (says exactly what the code does).

login.inDocker: Login page, first set-up: label before the command to run in a container.
welcome.uploadedFile: Setup guide, résumé step: state after an upload. {name}: the file's name.
welcome.uploadedOk: Setup guide, résumé step: state after an upload when the file's name is not known.
welcome.portalOption: Setup guide: a school portal that cannot be chosen, with why in brackets. {name}: school and portal; {note}: welcome.sameSystemNotSupported or welcome.noImporterYet.
welcome.tryIntro: Setup guide, 'Try once': introduction. {strong}: the words of welcome.nothingIsSubmittedAt, shown in bold.
settings.page.seeAlso: Small label before links to related settings (Settings → Search goals → Your search profile).
settings.page.sections: Accessible name of the row of links to the sections of the open settings group.
settings.page.sourcesMoved: Settings → Search goals → Sources and watched employers: says where these things are now; two link buttons follow (the Sources page, the Plan section).
settings.page.mailCannotBeUndone: One line under the choice of whether emails the app drafts are sent automatically. The details are behind an (i).
settings.page.templateInUse: State line in Settings → Cover letter: the file name of the Word template in use.
settings.page.noTemplate: State line in Settings → Cover letter when there is no Word template.
settings.page.channelKind: Accessible name of one checkbox of the notification matrix: the channel (Telegram, Discord) and the kind of notification.
settings.page.restoreAndMove: Summary of a disclosure in Settings → Backup and updates that holds the steps for restoring an export, moving and updating.
settings.page.unlinkAsk: Confirmation before unlinking the Discord account from the bot.
settings.ai.apiKey: Field label in Settings → AI service: the key of the chosen provider.
settings.ai.inParens: A plan's name in brackets after 'Signed in to …' (Settings → AI service). Keep the leading space in languages that put one before a bracket.
settings.ai.signOutAsk: Confirmation before signing the app out of the ChatGPT subscription.
settings.mailbox.removeAccessAsk: Confirmation before removing the Outlook mailbox authorization.
settings.browser.ruleFor: Column header of the browser rules: whether the rule is for an account or a domain.
settings.browser.usedFor: Column header of the browser rules: the kinds of work (sign in, scan, read, apply) the rule covers.
settings.browser.allWork: Shown in the 'Used for' column for an account rule, which always covers everything done on that site.
settings.browser.engineOwn: Option of a browser rule: the browser the app starts itself (Playwright).
settings.browser.engineOrdinary: Option of a browser rule: the user's ordinary Chrome or Edge, driven by nodriver.
settings.employers.openPage: Name and tooltip of the small link icon beside a watched employer: opens its careers page in a new tab.
sources.col.passed: Short column header of the sources report: how many postings passed the hard conditions. The long form is in its tooltip (sources.passedTheHardConditions).
sources.readFailed: State under the last-read time of a source whose latest read failed; the failure itself is in the tooltip and the opened row.
sources.failedTimes: State under the last-read time of a source whose last {n} reads in a row failed (n > 1). Keep it very short: it sits in a narrow table cell.
accounts.colCredential: Column header on Site accounts and label in an account's details: the saved password of the account (saved / not saved, shown on request).
accounts.colSession: Column header on Site accounts and label in an account's details: the cookies saved after a sign-in (saved at, expires by). Not 'signed in'.
application.tabsLabel: Accessible name of the tab row on one application's page (Record, Agent, Materials, Mail, Timeline, Posting). Not shown.
calendar.field.zone: Field in an item's details: the time and time zone the employer's e-mail gave, which the time shown was converted from.

calendar.zoneAssumed: Hint in an item's details when the e-mail gave a time without saying whose clock it is. “Change the time” is the name of the button (calendar.move).

settings.time.zoneHelp: Help behind the (i) of the time zone setting.
files.page.notSent: Group of postings in the files page's folder list: files written for applications that ended without being sent (withdrawn, not applying, posting closed).
about.changelog.title: About page: the tab with every version's changes (from CHANGELOG.md), and the name of that timeline.
about.changelog.search: About > Changelog: placeholder and accessible name of the search field over the changes (a version number such as 2.0.2 shows that version).
about.changelog.category: About > Changelog: name of the row of category chips (Added, Changed, Fixed...) that filter the changes.
about.changelog.kind.added: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - what is new (Keep a Changelog "Added").
about.changelog.kind.changed: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - existing behaviour that changed (Keep a Changelog "Changed"; not necessarily an improvement, never a fix).
about.changelog.kind.fixed: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - bugs that were fixed.
about.changelog.kind.security: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - security fixes.
about.changelog.kind.breaking: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - changes that break what worked before.
about.changelog.kind.removed: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - features that were taken out.
about.changelog.kind.deprecated: About > Changelog: label of a category of changes - features that will be removed later.
about.changelog.kind.known: About > Changelog: label of a category - known limitations of a version.
about.changelog.kind.other: About > Changelog: the filter chip and count for sections with a heading of their own ("The analysis page"); the sections themselves show their own (English) heading.
about.changelog.clear: About > Changelog: button that removes the search and the category filter.
about.changelog.matches: About > Changelog: how many changes match the search / category filter. {n} = number.
about.changelog.expandAll: About > Changelog: button that opens every version shown.
about.changelog.collapseAll: About > Changelog: button that closes every version shown to one line.
about.changelog.goTo: About > Changelog: accessible name and placeholder of the select that scrolls to a version and opens it.
about.changelog.versions: About > Changelog: title of the list of versions beside the timeline (wide windows); each opens and scrolls to its version.
about.changelog.current: About > Changelog: badge on the version that is running now.
about.changelog.unreleased: About > Changelog: title of the entry for changes made after the latest release (CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased]).
about.changelog.notReleased: About > Changelog: shown where a version's release date is, for the unreleased changes.
about.changelog.noDate: About > Changelog: shown where a release date is when CHANGELOG.md gives none for a version (none is made up).
about.changelog.compare: About > Changelog: link on a version to its comparison page on GitHub (the code changed since the version before).
about.changelog.compareTip: About > Changelog: tooltip of the Code changes link. {v} = version number.
about.changelog.compareUnreleased: About > Changelog: tooltip of the Code changes link of the unreleased changes.
about.changelog.release: About > Changelog: link on a version to its release page on GitHub.
about.changelog.releaseTip: About > Changelog: tooltip of the Release page link. {v} = version number.
about.changelog.link: About > Changelog: link on a version when CHANGELOG.md gives one that is neither a GitHub comparison nor a release page.
about.changelog.notFound: About > Changelog: the address names a version (?v=...) that CHANGELOG.md does not have. {v} = what the address says.
about.changelog.noneTitle: About > Changelog: empty state title when the program has no CHANGELOG.md (or it lists no version).
about.changelog.noneText: About > Changelog: empty state text under noneTitle.
about.changelog.noMatch: About > Changelog: empty state title when the search / category filter matches nothing.
about.changelog.noMatchText: About > Changelog: empty state text under noMatch.
about.changelog.noNotes: About > Changelog: an opened version whose entry in CHANGELOG.md has no text.
about.changelog.source: About > Changelog: one line under the timeline saying where the text comes from and that it is in English.
about.licenses.title: About page: the tab with the components the program runs on and their licences.
about.licenses.search: About > Licenses: placeholder and accessible name of the search field over the components.
about.licenses.col.name: About > Licenses: column header - the component's (Python package's) name.
about.licenses.col.version: About > Licenses: column header - the installed version of the component.
about.licenses.col.license: About > Licenses: column header, and the name of the licence filter - the component's licence as its package states it.
about.licenses.col.dependency: About > Licenses: column header and the name of its filter - whether the program asks for the component itself (direct) or another component does (indirect).
about.licenses.direct: About > Licenses: value of the Dependency column - the program itself declares this package.
about.licenses.indirect: About > Licenses: value of the Dependency column - another component needs this package.
about.licenses.all: About > Licenses: filter option - every component.
about.licenses.directOnly: About > Licenses: filter option - only the packages the program itself declares.
about.licenses.allLicenses: About > Licenses: licence filter option - every licence.
about.licenses.count: About > Licenses: how many components are listed. {n} = number.
about.licenses.source: About > Licenses: line under the table saying where the list and its licences come from (importlib.metadata of the installed packages) and where the interface's own libraries are listed.
about.licenses.homepage: About > Licenses > a component: link to the project's home page, as its package names it.
about.licenses.file: About > Licenses > a component: label of the path of the licence file(s) the text was read from, inside the installed package.
about.licenses.text: About > Licenses > a component: heading of the licence's full text.
about.licenses.noText: About > Licenses > a component: its installed package has no LICENSE / COPYING / NOTICE file and no licence text in its metadata.
about.licenses.noneTitle: About > Licenses: empty state title when no installed package could be read.
about.licenses.noneText: About > Licenses: empty state text under noneTitle.
about.licenses.noMatch: About > Licenses: empty state when the search / filters match nothing.
about.licenses.textOf: About > Licenses: what could not be loaded, in common.notRead ("Could not load {what}"). {name} = package name.
analytics.pace.title: Title of a card on Analytics > Outcomes: four figures - how long a posting (or an application) waits for its first record, how many to-dos are open, how many were handled in the period.
analytics.pace.medianOf: Small line under a duration figure: the figure is the median over {n} applications. Plural forms as usual.
analytics.pace.noRecords: Small line under a duration figure shown as a dash: no application got its first record in the chosen period.
analytics.pace.open: Label under a figure: how many to-dos (items of the Action required page) are open now.
analytics.pace.oldestWaits: Small line under analytics.pace.open: how long the oldest open to-do has waited. {time} is a formatted duration (3 days, 4 hr).
analytics.pace.snoozed: Small line under analytics.pace.open: how many of the open to-dos are snoozed (put off until later). Plural forms as usual.
analytics.pace.handled: Label under a figure: how many to-dos were handled (done or dismissed) in the chosen period.
analytics.pace.medianWait: Small line under analytics.pace.handled: the median time those to-dos waited before being handled. {time} is a formatted duration.
analytics.backlog.byKind: Title of a card: a table of the to-dos handled in the period, one row per kind (answer questions, sign in to a site, ...).
analytics.backlog.byKindHelp: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.backlog.byKind.
analytics.backlog.otherKinds: Name of a small box that lists the kinds of to-do not shown in the card (the less frequent ones).
analytics.backlog.moreKinds: Button at the bottom of analytics.backlog.byKind: opens a box with the {n} kinds of to-do not shown. Plural forms as usual.
analytics.backlog.oldestHelp: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.backlog.oldest. "Action required" is the page's name (app.needsYou).
analytics.backlog.viewAll: Link at the top right of analytics.backlog.oldest: opens the Action required page with all {n} open to-dos. Plural forms as usual.
analytics.backlog.item: Column header: the to-do (its title, and under it its kind).
analytics.backlog.state: Column header: where the to-do stands (snoozed, its date, the posting's deadline).
analytics.backlog.waited: Column header: how long the to-do has been open (a duration).
analytics.backlog.st.snoozed: Status of an open to-do that was put off: shown again on {day} (a formatted date).
analytics.backlog.st.datePassed: Status of an open to-do with a date of its own (an interview, an assessment) that has passed.
analytics.backlog.st.on: Status of an open to-do with a date of its own (an interview, an assessment) still to come. {day} is a formatted date.
analytics.backlog.st.closed: Status of an open to-do about a posting whose application deadline has passed.
analytics.backlog.st.closes: Status of an open to-do about a posting: the posting's application deadline, still to come. {day} is a formatted date.
analytics.backlog.st.open: Status of an open to-do with no date, not snoozed.

about.tab.changelog: About page: the tab with every version's changes.

about.runtime: About page: the expandable section with Python, the operating system, how it runs, the data folder and the build.

about.copied: Toast after a path was copied.
about.copyFailed: Toast when the browser refused the clipboard.
about.copyDiagnostics: Button in the runtime details: copies the facts of this copy as plain text, for an issue report.
about.diagnosticsCopied: Toast after the diagnostics were copied.
about.diagnosticsHint: Help beside "Copy diagnostics": exactly what is copied.
about.state.unchecked: Update state: no check for updates has been made.
about.state.checking: Update state: a check is under way.
about.state.current: Update state: no newer release was found.
about.state.newer: Update state: a newer release is out. {v}: its version.
about.state.preparing: Update state: unpacking it and installing what it needs. {v}: the version.

about.fact.latest: Label in the updates card: the newest release found on the channel.

about.fact.switching: Label in the updates card: the release a switch was asked for.
about.fact.pending: Label in the updates card: the release the tray app starts at its next restart (staged by a switch or by hand).

about.fact.previous: Label in the updates card: the release run before the last switch, kept to go back to.

about.modesNotHere: Under the update modes, on a source checkout or a container: why two modes are not offered.
about.privacyShort: Privacy statement under the update policy, always visible; the whole of it is in "How updates work".
about.howItWorks: Expandable section: what is sent where, how a switch works, what idle means.
about.idleHow: In "How updates work": when an automatic switch may happen.
